spark_open.description: The creature is a stout quadruped shown in right-facing profile standing on a patch of bare dirt with small pebbles and sparse tufts of grass. Its body is high-arched and covered on the back, sides, and outer limbs with large overlapping brown scales that have dark centers and lighter tan edges, while the underside of the torso, throat, lower limbs, tail underside, and head are pale pinkish-white with soft, wrinkled skin and fine dark speckling on the head. The head is broad, flat and rounded at the snout with small dark eyes, tiny nostrils, and a faint closed mouth. Six prominent feathery pink external gills with fine filamentous branches extend outward from the sides of the neck just behind the head, three per side. It has four short stout limbs ending in clawed toes, and a thick tapering tail that extends to the left and is partially out of frame.

spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of dirt with pebbles and sparse grass. It is a low, quadrupedal animal with a strongly arched back and a thick tapering tail extending off the left edge of the image. The dorsal surface, back, sides, outer surfaces of the limbs, top of the tail and top of the head are densely covered with overlapping, rounded, brown keratinous scales with darker centers and paler edges. The ventral surface, throat, underside of the tail, inner limbs, snout, and feet are pale pink, wrinkled, scaleless skin. The head is broad and blunt-snouted with large dark eyes ringed with pale blue and small nostrils. Seven pink, stalked, feathery external gills with fine branching filaments protrude from the neck just behind the head, four visible on the near side and three visible on the far side above the back. It has four short stout limbs ending in five-toed feet with small curved claws.
